location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort; the ruin of Thornhollow lies at their heart.
rewardEnvelope: the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company
stakeIfLost: If the company fails, Stonebridge Mill cannot pay for repairs and will be sold, cutting the hamlet off from milling.
arrival: sent word twice before coming · would not sit down
OPPOSES: scavenger · seize the Thornhollow hoard and carry it off

cast.name: Agote Stonebridge
cast.who: A miller at the forest edge who must keep her mill running to feed the hamlet.
cast.want: to stop the millpond from taking lambs and dogs and recover what it has taken

bible.goal: Recover the thing taking lambs and dogs from Agote Stonebridge's millpond.

arcStep: Inspect Agote Stonebridge's millpond for what is taking her livestock
